faq.title: Questions, answered.
faq.a1: Ferry adds no fee of its own. Fonbnk offers show its rate and fee; M-Pesa Direct already includes Tando’s fee of about 1% in the amount shown; Lightning routes add Nimiq Pay’s swap fee, which it shows before you approve. Ferry tops up Polygon gas for USDT transfers, so you don’t need a gas token.
faq.a2: From about 1 USDT up to 200 USDT per cash-out. M-Pesa Direct goes up to KSh 49,000 at a time, and airtime has lower caps per country.
faq.a3: M-Pesa Direct usually lands in about a minute, with the M-Pesa receipt shown in Ferry. Fonbnk payouts usually take a few minutes after you hand back the transaction.
faq.a4: Lightning routes are atomic: if the payout doesn’t happen, the payment fails back to your wallet. Fonbnk orders stay open with Fonbnk, and History takes you back to finish or check them.
faq.q5: Which countries can I cash out to?
faq.a5: Nigeria, Kenya, Ghana, South Africa, Uganda, Tanzania, Rwanda, Zambia, The Gambia, Senegal, Côte d’Ivoire, Cameroon and Brazil, to banks or mobile money. Airtime works in 11 of them, and you can add money in 6.
faq.a6: No. Your wallet pays the payout partner directly, and every approval happens in Nimiq Pay. Ferry’s code is open source under the MIT licence.

proof.title: Proof of Ferry
proof.lede: Every cash-out Ferry can prove, on-chain or by M-Pesa receipt, counted in public. No names, no account numbers.
proof.failed: We couldn't load the numbers. Check your connection and try again.
proof.empty: No public cash-outs yet. The first ones will show here the moment they happen.
proof.how1: A cash-out counts once Ferry can prove it: the user’s own USDT transfer to Fonbnk on Polygon, or an M-Pesa receipt for an M-Pesa Direct payout. Each row links to its proof.
proof.how2: The median time and “Confirmed received” use M-Pesa receipts where there is one, and otherwise senders tapping “I’ve got my money” in Ferry.
proof.how3: Unique wallets counts on-chain senders only: a Lightning payout doesn’t reveal the paying wallet.
proof.how4: NIM turned into USDT counts once LendaSwap reports the swap complete and Ferry sees the USDT reach the swap’s own address on Polygon. It’s shown apart from cash-outs, since the cash-out that follows is counted on its own.
